observations: Photo 0 shows a sewing machine on a treadle stand in a professional studio setting with a plain grey background.
Photos 1 and 2 show a sewing machine in a domestic setting with floral curtains and poor lighting.
The brand 'NEW HOME' is visible on the machine head in all photos.
The brand 'NEW HOME' is cast into the metal of the treadle base and footplate in photo 0.
The wooden table in photo 0 has a plain, finished edge.
The wooden table in photos 1 and 2 has a black and white ruler tape applied along the front edge.
An electric foot pedal and power cord are visible on the table in all photos.
A treadle belt is connected in photo 0.
All photos carry a watermark 'OLUSOLA LARRY' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows both a manual treadle base and an electric foot pedal with motor wiring.

risks.risk: The seller may not possess the item shown in the professional photo.
risks.proof: A single photo or video showing the machine with the ruler tape in the same setting as the professional shot.

risks.risk: The electric motor may be burnt out or non-functional.
risks.proof: Video of the machine running under electric power.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical timing issues or skipped stitches.
risks.proof: Photo of a fabric sample showing zig-zag and straight stitches produced by this machine.

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric using the electric motor.
Photo of the machine head showing the model number plate usually located on the side or back.
Clear photo of the machine in the domestic setting showing the treadle base to confirm it matches photo 0.
response.reason: There is a significant discrepancy between the photos. Photo 0 is a professional studio shot of a unit with a plain table, while photos 1 and 2 are amateur shots of a unit with a ruler tape on the table. This suggests the seller is using images of different items or stock photography.
